title: Compass: Hub advisor — dynamic HTML dashboard, morning brief, decision tracker, productivity metrics
description: The Compass is the user-facing hub advisor. It gathers data from Gardener (fleet health, work executed) and Lathe (strategic weights, shift directions, budgets), then generates a dynamic HTML dashboard personalized to the user's tone (from taste files). The dashboard presents decision points for easy approval, tracks decision history, and measures productivity. It is the autopilot — aware of everything happening across all spokes, informing the user of what matters, and making approval as frictionless as possible.
acceptance_criteria: Hub advisor at WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/ with scan_state.json, passes.jsonl, reports/
Dynamic HTML output generated per run — served locally or opened in browser
Reads taste.user.yaml for tone and communication preferences
Reads Gardener scan_state + Lathe spoke_lathe.json for data
Dashboard sections: fleet status, attention priorities, decision queue, productivity trends
Decision queue: items needing user go/no-go with one-click approve/defer/reject
Decision history: timestamped log of all user decisions with context
Productivity metrics: lugs completed/week, teachings adopted/week, spokes tended, cost/spoke
Trend lines: spoke health over time, autonomy ratio trend, attention allocation vs plan
Research mode: surfaces relevant ideas/opportunities with implementation-ready briefs
Runs as part of gardener nightly OR on-demand via /wai-compass

architecture.output: HTML dashboard + JSON report + decision queue file
architecture.history: WAI-Hub/advisors/compass/decisions.jsonl — every decision with timestamp, context, outcome

vision.morning_flow: Wake up → open compass dashboard → see 3 decisions to make → approve/defer → gardener executes tonight
vision.productivity: Measurable: lugs/week, cost/spoke, attention minutes vs plan, autonomy ratio trend
vision.research: Compass finds ideas in the wild (trends, tools, opportunities) and prepares implementation-ready briefs
vision.tone: Dashboard reflects user's communication style from taste files — not generic, not robotic
